summary: Implemented native selectable current-workspace diffs with durable run/path and live workspace validation, bounded patch response and explicit unavailable states. Compacted run hierarchy and historical disclosures, collapsed updates, and added live-only reduced-motion-safe animation. Typecheck/build/diff-check pass; 74 focused tests pass; Steel component-preview checks pass desktop/panel/mobile and reduced motion. Preview uses a diff stand-in, so installed native renderer visual verification remains pending. Plugin installed from this checkout; formal review and integration not claimed.

state.request: Fix the Taskboard automatic-start behavior that pauses work when a build reports recoverable blockers like the supplied Roten-App result. Improve automatic work startup so blocker summaries are handled accurately and the task does not stop prematurely when actionable implementation work can continue, while preserving genuine human-decision, tracker, evidence, and policy gates.

sizeDecision.reason: This is the third refinement of one already-implemented and installed Taskboard delivery branch. The progress UI now depends on the same Factory run contract and navigation introduced by the earlier build-resumption iteration, while ticket drafting is already implemented. Splitting now would duplicate history and destabilize the installed local feature; keep one revision and verify capabilities independently.
